∀ {d m : ℕ} {f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ} {x0 : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d}
  {lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
    (∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →
      (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
          ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x - gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ≤
            Lminus * ‖x - y‖) →
        (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
            (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
          (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
              (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -
                  ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                        gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                    2 ≤
                Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ →
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ

{d m : ℕ} →
  {f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ} →
    {x0 : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
      {lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ} →
        {motive : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ → Sort u} →
          ((differentiable : ∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
              (lower_bound :
                  ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →
                (smooth :
                    ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                      ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                            gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ≤
                        Lminus * ‖x - y‖) →
                  (mean_square :
                      ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                        (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                    (centered :
                        ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                          (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -
                              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                                    gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                                2 ≤
                            Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                      (gap : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ) → motive ⋯) →
            (t : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ) → motive t

          (t : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ) →
            ((differentiable : ∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
                (lower_bound :
                    ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →
                  (smooth :
                      ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                        ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                              gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ≤
                          Lminus * ‖x - y‖) →
                    (mean_square :
                        ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                          (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                      (centered :
                          ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                            (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -
                                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                                      gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                                  2 ≤
                              Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                        (gap : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ) → motive ⋯) →
              motive t
